propositions: Jira-family-general symbols (identity convention, probe classifier, field sanitizers, link vocabulary, status/priority maps) are currently scattered across adapters/jira/ without a unified, publicly-importable home, violating the one-level-deep core↔adapter seam mandated by ADR 0035.

The value maps _LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA and _LOCAL_PRIORITY_TO_JIRA exist in two independent copies (jira_fields.py and outbound_fields.py) that have drifted, with deleted status mapping disagreement that causes silent invalid Jira transitions in the ACLI path.

Moving jira_fields.py wholesale to jira_family/ would invert the dependency direction by making jira_family/ import from pinned modules (adf.py, comment_limits.py), so the extraction must split jira_fields.py by symbol and inject sanitizer dependencies as contract objects rather than imports.

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) loaded via spec_from_file_location in tests cannot move paths; they must be refactored by dependency inversion (importing jira_family/ contracts) rather than relocation.
Absolute imports (never relative) must be used in pinned modules since they are loaded under synthetic names with __package__=='', where relative imports fail with ImportError.

The deleted status deliberately transitions from invalid "Deleted" (current ACLI fallback) to valid "Done" (matching outbound_fields and config.py), a declared observable behavior change in an otherwise behavior-preserving refactor.
